findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The PIC was observed to make a sanitizer bucket that tested to be at 0ppm of Quaternary ammonium. The PIC used the sanitizer dispenser to fill the bottom of the bucket and then filled the rest with water. The PIC was educated that the sanitizer dispenser is diluted and does not need to be mixed with more water. CORRECTED- The sanitizer bucket was remade using only the dispenser and tested to be at 200ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that sanitizer buckets are at a label-recommended concentration to make sure that food-contact surfaces are being properly sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There was not a sanitizer bucket made at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- A sanitizer bucket was made and tested to be at 200ppm of Quaternary ammonium. The PIC was educated to make sure that there is always a sanitizer bucket made and available during all hours of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

The wiping cloth that was being used to wipe food-contact surfaces was observed to be stored on the counter. This was discussed with the PIC and a bucket was recommended, as they often use the sanitizer from the Schnuck’s deli’s triple sink. CORRECTED- The PIC filled a sanitizer bucket and was educated that the wiping cloth should be stored in chemical sanitizer in between uses to prevent bacteria growth.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the utility sink in the sushi area to be pulled away from the wall and leaning. Ensure the sink is repaired and sealed to the wall prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
